::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
## How to use this page

Find the current week (outlined), read the Topic before Tuesday, do the Analysis, and push your notebook entry by Friday 5:00 PM. The Project line is what should move in your own project that week. Everything about the loop itself is on [How We Work](how-we-work.qmd).
:::

<script>
// Outline the current week's card and mute past weeks, based on the
// data-start / data-end attributes above. Exposed on window so it can be
// tested with an arbitrary date from the console: markCurrentWeek(new Date("2026-10-14")).
window.markCurrentWeek = function (today) {
  today = today || new Date();
  var day = today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  document.querySelectorAll(".schedule-card[data-start]").forEach(function (card) {
    card.classList.remove("current", "past");
    var start = card.getAttribute("data-start"), end = card.getAttribute("data-end");
    if (day >= start && day <= end) card.classList.add("current");
    else if (day > end) card.classList.add("past");
  });
};
window.markCurrentWeek();
</script>
